tasks.short: Record an address change and redirect.

steps.what: List stored address fields for the change
Record address changes for those addresses
Decide the redirect for those addresses
Sign the redirect instruction
File only the signed redirect instruction
outputs: filed copy of signed redirect instruction v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists the stored address fields. The carrier records the address changes and decides the redirect. A later job files only the signed instruction. It does not redirect unsigned mail. A blank new address is not a redirect.
tasks.previous_blocker: Redirects were a pencil mark on the old address.
tasks.enabler_now: Old address, new address, and customer identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding the redirect stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the new address is usable.

ambition.what: Sign the redirect the day the stored address changes.

tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the change, not on listing fields.

reach.task: Have mail redirected only as the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Old address, new address, and customer identifier are stored on the address record. The address record produces them. A blank new address is not a redirect. Only the signed instruction is filed.
Native configuration of the address record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier recording address changes for those addresses.

incremental.description: Refresh old address, new address, and customer identifier when the address layout changes, and drop an instruction the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many new addresses are blank. The high end assumes old address, new address, and customer identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List mail whose stored address does not match
Return incorrectly addressed mail to senders
Decide the sender when the address is blank
Sign the return instruction
File the signed return instruction
outputs: filed copy of signed return instruction v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists mail whose stored address does not match. The carrier returns incorrectly addressed mail to senders and decides the sender when the address is blank. A later job files the signed instruction in {DOCS}. It does not guess a sender and it does not send the piece by itself.
tasks.previous_blocker: Bad addresses were spotted only at the door.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier, stored address, and sender name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Carrying the piece back stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides who the sender is.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the return, not on listing mismatches.

reach.task: Receive a return only when the carrier signed it

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Item identifier, stored address, and sender name are stored on the item record. The item record produces them. A blank address is not treated as a match. A blank sender name is not guessed. The carrier returns the piece.
Native configuration of the item record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier returning incorrectly addressed mail to senders.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier, stored address, and sender name when the address layout changes, and drop an instruction the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many sender names are blank. The high end assumes item identifier, stored address, and sender name are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List the stored postal rule for the question
Answer customers' questions about postal services
Apply the regulations only when the rule is stored
Sign the answer note
File the signed answer note
outputs: filed copy of signed answer note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists the stored postal rule and does not speak. The carrier answers the customers' questions about postal services and regulations. A later job files the signed note. There is no answer desk and no chatbot.
tasks.previous_blocker: Answers varied because the rule was not stored.
tasks.enabler_now: Question text and rule identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The answer stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the rule applies.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week answering, not on listing rules.

reach.task: Hear the answer from the carrier

evidence.claim: The executive digest says customer questions are an answer desk quoting the firm's rules, otherwise a person takes over. This design has no answer desk. The carrier answers.

assumptions: Question text and rule identifier are stored on the rule record. The rule record produces them. A blank rule identifier means the carrier does not quote a rule. The job does not answer by itself.
Native configuration of the rule record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier answering customers' questions about postal services.

incremental.description: Refresh question text and rule identifier when the rule layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many rule identifiers are blank. The high end assumes question text and rule identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hand over address cards and forms.

steps.what: List stored change of address forms
Provide customers with change of address cards
Hand over the other forms in person
Sign the form note
File the signed form note
outputs: filed copy of signed form note v1

tasks.design: A job in {DOCS} lists stored change of address forms. The carrier provides the cards and hands over the other forms. A later job files the signed note. It does not submit a form.
tasks.previous_blocker: Forms were grabbed from a drawer with no count.
tasks.enabler_now: Form name and customer identifier are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Handing over the form stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides which form applies.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week handing over forms, not on listing them.

reach.task: Receive only the form the carrier handed over

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Form name and customer identifier are stored on the form record. The form record produces them. A blank form name is not handed out. Filing the note does not submit the form.
Native configuration of the form record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier providing customers with change of address cards.

incremental.description: Refresh form name and customer identifier when the form layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many form names are blank. The high end assumes form name and customer identifier are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, with the mail, and on the signed note. A stored list and filing that signature can move. The carrier still walks, sorts, collects, and signs.
reach: A patron receives only the mail the carrier delivered.
A publisher receives only the form the carrier signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a redirect the carrier has not signed.
Reject a receipt when the label does not match.
Reject a charge that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed hold or address change can be filed the same day, and the carrier still walks the route.
